name: Karappo no Yakusoku
source:
A game where you simply watch the fall of a girl who is no longer human due to an experiment.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9617]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
在這部遊戲裡，你只需靜靜看著一個因實驗而不再是人類的女孩走向沉淪。

［摘自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9617]NovelGame[/url]］
